name: recap
description: One-page project recap from the chat sessions of every local coding agent, weighted toward recent work.

interface.shortDescription: One-page recap from all your coding agents' chats.
interface.longDescription: Recap reads this project's local sessions from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Factory Droid, and Pi, and turns the user prompts and final agent answers into a one-page summary. Recent work gets the most detail.
defaultPrompt: Catch me up on this project.
What have my coding agents done here recently?
Summarize where this project stands and what's next.
